func _ready() -> void:
	get_tree().auto_accept_quit=false
	capture_mode=OS.get_cmdline_user_args().has("--capture")
	world=WorldScene.new()
	add_child(world)
	audio=Audio.new()
	add_child(audio)
	world.coastal_play.note_requested.connect(audio.play_note)
	story=Story.new()
	definitions=Session.definitions()
	_build_ui()
	world.interaction_requested.connect(_interact)
	world.area_changed.connect(func(name: String):
		area_label.text=name
		_update_breadcrumb(name)
		_sync_audio_environment()
		if session==null: audio.play_context("harbor" if name=="海風碼頭" else "plaza")
	)
	Progress.changed.connect(_refresh)
	Localization.locale_changed.connect(_on_locale_changed)
	Progress.achievement_unlocked.connect(_achievement_toast)
	_refresh()
	audio.play_context("harbor")
	if capture_mode:
		world.player.position=Vector3(0,0.4,9)
		_capture_sequence.call_deferred()
	elif not Progress.intro_seen:
		_show_arrival()
	var user_args := OS.get_cmdline_user_args()
	if user_args.has("--smoke-test"):
		if user_args.has("--smoke-art"):
			_smoke_art_test.call_deferred()
		else:
			_smoke_test.call_deferred()

func _smoke_test() -> void:
	if OS.get_environment("SNAPLAND_SAVE_PATH").is_empty():
		push_error("Smoke test requires isolated SNAPLAND_SAVE_PATH")
		get_tree().quit(1)
		return
	await get_tree().create_timer(0.5).timeout
	print("PASS: game startup and clean shutdown")
	await _quit_game()

func _smoke_art_test() -> void:
	if DisplayServer.get_name()=="headless":
		await _smoke_art_abort("--smoke-art requires a GPU-backed, non-headless display")
		return
	var review_profile := OS.get_environment("SNAPLAND_SAVE_PATH")
	if not review_profile.is_absolute_path():
		await _smoke_art_abort("--smoke-art requires an absolute isolated SNAPLAND_SAVE_PATH")
		return
	var review_directory := review_profile.get_base_dir()
	var directory_error := DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(review_directory)
	if directory_error != OK and directory_error != ERR_ALREADY_EXISTS:
		await _smoke_art_abort("Could not prepare the private art review directory")
		return
	var final_status: Dictionary={}
	var final_ready := false
	for game_index in range(1,13):
		var id := "game-%03d"%game_index
		_launch_game(id,false)
		if session==null or session.game_id!=id:
			await _smoke_art_abort("Could not start art smoke game %s"%id)
			return
		# Let the CanvasItem draw the real game frame before checking its shared caches.
		await get_tree().process_frame
		await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw
		await get_tree().create_timer(0.08).timeout
		await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw
		if not is_instance_valid(session.presentation) or not session.presentation.is_visible_in_tree() or session.presentation_mode != session.mode:
			await _smoke_art_abort("The actual minigame renderer did not become visible: %s"%id)
			return
		var image := get_viewport().get_texture().get_image()
		var capture := review_directory.path_join("art-smoke-%s.png"%id)
		if image == null or image.is_empty() or FileAccess.file_exists(capture) or image.save_png(capture) != OK:
			await _smoke_art_abort("Could not preserve a fresh rendered frame for %s"%id)
			return
		print("ART SMOKE DRAW: %s renderer=%s capture=%s"%[id,session.presentation.get_script().resource_path,capture])
		if Session._backdrop_warning_emitted or Session._props_warning_emitted or not world.foliage_warnings.is_empty():
			await _smoke_art_abort("An art resource warning occurred while drawing %s"%id)
			return
		if game_index==12:
			# Bespoke 2D/3D renderers need not draw the old common backdrop.
			# Resolve every shared region separately; do not call it gameplay use.
			if not session.resolve_shared_art_resources():
				await _smoke_art_abort("Shared art resource resolution is incomplete")
				return
			final_status=session.art_cache_status()
			final_ready=session.art_assets_ready()
		_cancel_game()
		await get_tree().process_frame
		await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw
	# Explicit resolution above proves unused prop regions load as Texture2D; it
	# does not claim those props were drawn by a game.
	var expected_scenes: Array[String]=Session.BACKDROP_SCENES.duplicate()
	var loaded_scenes: Array=final_status.get("backdrops_loaded",[])
	var missing_scenes: Array=final_status.get("backdrops_missing",[])
	if not final_ready or not bool(final_status.get("backdrop_atlas_loaded",false)) or not missing_scenes.is_empty() or loaded_scenes.size()!=expected_scenes.size():
		await _smoke_art_abort("Backdrop cache incomplete: %s"%str(final_status))
		return
	if not bool(final_status.get("props_atlas_loaded",false)) or not bool(final_status.get("props_regions_loaded",false)) or not final_status.get("props_missing",[]).is_empty() or final_status.get("props_loaded",[]).size()!=Session.REQUIRED_PROP_KEYS.size():
		await _smoke_art_abort("Prop cache incomplete: %s"%str(final_status))
		return
	var foliage_keys: Array[String]=["oak","ginkgo","palm","pine","shrub","planter","rocks","lamp"]
	var actual_foliage_keys: Array[String]=[]
	for key in world.foliage_textures:
		actual_foliage_keys.append(str(key))
		if not world.foliage_textures[key] is Texture2D:
			await _smoke_art_abort("Foliage '%s' is not a Texture2D"%str(key))
			return
	actual_foliage_keys.sort()
	foliage_keys.sort()
	if not world.foliage_atlas_loaded or actual_foliage_keys!=foliage_keys or not world.foliage_warnings.is_empty():
		await _smoke_art_abort("Foliage cache incomplete or warned: %s"%str(actual_foliage_keys))
		return
	if Session._backdrop_warning_emitted or Session._props_warning_emitted:
		await _smoke_art_abort("A minigame art resource warning was emitted during the smoke test")
		return
	var avatar_source=world.avatar_renderer
	if not avatar_source.is_asset_ready() or not avatar_source.has_hat_atlas() or not avatar_source.has_hair_atlas() or not avatar_source.has_species_atlas() or not avatar_source.has_walk_atlas() or not avatar_source.has_diagonal_parts():
		await _smoke_art_abort("Character, hair, hat or species atlas failed to load from the exported resources")
		return
	if world.identity_textures.size()!=3 or not world.identity_warnings.is_empty():
		await _smoke_art_abort("Named character atlas regions failed to load")
		return
	for actor_role in ["ticket", "imp", "announcer"]:
		if world.npc_activity.load_action_frames(actor_role).size() != 4:
			await _smoke_art_abort("Authored NPC activity assets failed to load: " + actor_role)
			return
	var motion_status:Dictionary=world.component_motion.statistics()
	if not bool(motion_status.get("playing",false)) or int(motion_status.get("registration_count",0))<100:
		await _smoke_art_abort("Scene component animation did not start")
		return
	if int(world.occlusion_controller.statistics().get("registered_buildings",0))<15:
		await _smoke_art_abort("Eligible building cutaways were not registered")
		return
	print("PASS: character source assets, three NPC regions, component animation and building cutaway registration")
	print("PASS: art resources loaded (props=%d, scenes=%d, foliage=%d)"%[Session.REQUIRED_PROP_KEYS.size(),loaded_scenes.size(),actual_foliage_keys.size()])
	_cancel_game()
	world.blocked=true
	world.set_process(false)
	audio.shutdown()
	await get_tree().create_timer(0.15).timeout
	get_tree().quit()

func _smoke_art_abort(reason: String) -> void:
	push_error("ART SMOKE FAILED: "+reason)
	if session!=null: _cancel_game()
	world.blocked=true
	world.set_process(false)
	audio.shutdown()
	await get_tree().create_timer(0.15).timeout
	get_tree().quit(1)

func _notification(what: int) -> void:
	if what==NOTIFICATION_WM_CLOSE_REQUEST: _quit_game()

func _quit_game() -> void:
	if quitting: return
	quitting=true
	world.blocked=true
	Progress.save_progress()
	audio.shutdown()
	# Let the audio server consume stop commands before releasing the scene.
	await get_tree().create_timer(0.15).timeout
	get_tree().quit()

		if not is_instance_valid(breadcrumbs[i]): continue
		breadcrumbs[i].add_theme_color_override("font_color",Paper.CORAL if i==active else Color("#80918a"))
		breadcrumbs[i].add_theme_font_size_override("font_size",14 if i==active else 12)

		overlay.remove_child(child)

	# including its ink and panel face, above that active session.
	overlay.move_to_front()
	if is_instance_valid(session):
		session.set_paused(true)
		session.set_process_unhandled_input(false)
	overlay.show()
	modal_kind=kind
	world.blocked=true

func _content_pager(parent: VBoxContainer, node_name: String, entries: Array, render: Callable, capacity: int, navigation_parent: Node = null) -> VBoxContainer:
	var pager := VBoxContainer.new()
	pager.name=node_name
	pager.size_flags_horizontal=Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	pager.size_flags_vertical=Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	pager.add_theme_constant_override("separation",8)
	parent.add_child(pager)
	pager.set_meta("page_entries",entries)
	pager.set_meta("page_renderer",render)
	pager.set_meta("page_capacity",capacity)
	var view := VBoxContainer.new()
	view.name="PageContent"
	view.size_flags_vertical=Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	view.size_flags_horizontal=Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	view.add_theme_constant_override("separation",10)
	if node_name=="TaskPages":
		var viewport := ScrollContainer.new()
		viewport.name="AdaptiveMenuScroll"
		viewport.size_flags_horizontal=Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
		viewport.size_flags_vertical=Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
		viewport.horizontal_scroll_mode=ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_DISABLED
		viewport.vertical_scroll_mode=ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_DISABLED
		pager.add_child(viewport)
		viewport.add_child(view)
	else:
		pager.add_child(view)
	var navigation := HBoxContainer.new()
	navigation.name=node_name+"Navigation"
	navigation.add_theme_constant_override("separation",8)
	navigation.alignment=BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_END
	(navigation_parent if navigation_parent!=null else pager).add_child(navigation)
	pager.set_meta("page_navigation",navigation)
	var previous := Paper.button("‹",_step_content_page.bind(pager,-1),navigation)
	previous.name=node_name+"Previous"
	previous.tooltip_text="上一頁"
	var counter := Paper.label("",16,Paper.TEAL)
	counter.name="PageCounter"
	counter.autowrap_mode=TextServer.AUTOWRAP_OFF
	counter.size_flags_horizontal=Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
	navigation.add_child(counter)
	var next := Paper.button("›",_step_content_page.bind(pager,1),navigation)
	next.name=node_name+"Next"
	next.tooltip_text="下一頁"
	_render_content_page(pager,0)
	return pager

func _step_content_page(pager: VBoxContainer, amount: int) -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(pager): return
	_render_content_page(pager,int(pager.get_meta("page_index",0))+amount)
	var navigation: HBoxContainer=pager.get_meta("page_navigation")
	for control in navigation.get_children():
		if control is Button and not control.disabled:
			control.grab_focus()
			break

func _render_content_page(pager: VBoxContainer, requested: int) -> void:
	var entries: Array=pager.get_meta("page_entries")
	var capacity: int=pager.get_meta("page_capacity")
	var count := maxi(1,ceili(float(entries.size())/capacity))
	var index := clampi(requested,0,count-1)
	pager.set_meta("page_index",index)
	pager.set_meta("page_count",count)
	var view := pager.find_child("PageContent",true,false) as VBoxContainer
	for child in view.get_children():
		view.remove_child(child)
		child.queue_free()
	var renderer: Callable=pager.get_meta("page_renderer")
	for item in range(index*capacity,mini((index+1)*capacity,entries.size())):
		renderer.call(view,entries[item],item)
	var navigation: HBoxContainer=pager.get_meta("page_navigation")
	(navigation.get_child(0) as Button).disabled=index==0
	(navigation.get_child(1) as Label).text="%d / %d"%[index+1,count]
	(navigation.get_child(2) as Button).disabled=index==count-1
	navigation.visible=count>1
	call_deferred("_adapt_open_menu")

func _adapt_content_pagers(compact: bool) -> void:
	for node in overlay.find_children("*","VBoxContainer",true,false):
		if not node.has_meta("page_entries"): continue
		var capacity := int(node.get_meta("page_capacity"))
		var desired := capacity
		if node.name=="TaskPages": desired=1 if compact else 2
		elif node.name=="ResultScorePages": desired=1 if compact or Paper.text_scale()>1.1 else 2
		if desired!=capacity:
			var first := int(node.get_meta("page_index",0))*capacity
			node.set_meta("page_capacity",desired)
			_render_content_page(node,floori(float(first)/desired))

	if session!=null and DisplayServer.get_name()!="headless" and session.elapsed>=next_snapshot and not session.ended:

		_sample_photo.call_deferred()

		var has_context: bool = not world.nearest.is_empty() or world.is_riding()
		context_bar.visible=has_context

		if has_context:
			var prompt := _context_prompt()
			if context_action.text!=prompt:
				context_action.text=prompt
				_adapt_hud()
	if modal_kind=="dialogue" and is_instance_valid(dialogue_label) and dialogue_label.visible_characters>=0:
		var previous_count := dialogue_label.visible_characters
		reveal+=delta*34.0*float(Progress.settings.get("text_speed",1.0))
		var next_count := mini(int(reveal), dialogue_label.text.length())
		dialogue_label.visible_characters=next_count
		for char_index in range(previous_count, next_count):
			var current_speaker := str(dialogue[dialogue_index].get("speaker", "")) if dialogue_index < dialogue.size() else ""
			audio.play_dialogue_beep(current_speaker, dialogue_label.text.substr(char_index, 1))

func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:

		_next_dialogue()
		get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
	elif event is InputEventKey and event.pressed and not event.echo and event.keycode==KEY_C:

	var frame_path := str(saved_paths.get("thumbnail", ""))

	if frame_path.is_empty() or not _can_capture_time_postcard(phase_id, token):

		return ""

		_remove_photo_paths([frame_path, original_path])
		return ""
	return frame_path

func _can_capture_time_postcard(phase_id: String, token: int) -> bool:
	return token == time_capture_token and modal_kind == "time" and session == null and is_instance_valid(world) and str(world.nearest.get("id", "")) == "guide" and str(Progress.settings.get("time_phase", "")) == phase_id and TimeOfDay.phase_ids().has(phase_id) and not Progress.photos.has(TimeOfDay.postcard_id(phase_id))

func _capture_time_postcard_frame(phase_id: String, token: int) -> Dictionary:
	if not _can_capture_time_postcard(phase_id, token):
		return {}
	var overlay_was_visible := overlay.visible
	var hud_was_visible := hud.visible
	overlay.hide()
	hud.hide()
	await get_tree().process_frame
	if not _can_capture_time_postcard(phase_id, token):
		_restore_time_capture_ui(token, overlay_was_visible, hud_was_visible)
		return {}
	await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw
	if not _can_capture_time_postcard(phase_id, token):
		_restore_time_capture_ui(token, overlay_was_visible, hud_was_visible)
		return {}
	var viewport := get_viewport()
	var snapshot := viewport.get_texture().get_image() if is_instance_valid(viewport) else null
	_restore_time_capture_ui(token, overlay_was_visible, hud_was_visible)
	if snapshot == null or snapshot.is_empty() or not _can_capture_time_postcard(phase_id, token):
		return {}
	var original := _prepare_photo_original(snapshot)
	var thumbnail := _prepare_photo_thumbnail(original)
	var directory := _photo_directory()
	var error := DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(directory)
	if error != OK and error != ERR_ALREADY_EXISTS:
		push_warning("Cannot create time postcard directory: " + directory)
		return {}
	var base_path := directory + "/" + TimeOfDay.postcard_id(phase_id)
	var path := base_path + ".png"
	var original_path := base_path + "-original.png"
	if thumbnail.save_png(path) != OK or not _save_bounded_photo_image(original, original_path):
		_remove_photo_paths([path, original_path])
		push_warning("Cannot save time postcard image: " + path)
		return {}
	return {"thumbnail": path, "original": original_path}

	_finish_tutorial_panel()
	if target=="park":
		if origin=="session" and session!=null:

			session.set_paused(false)
		return
	if origin=="session" and session!=null:
		world.set_process(true)
		session.set_paused(false)
		return
	if target.begins_with("game-"):
		if origin in ["first_entry", "game_info"] and not Progress.mark_game_tutorial_seen(target):
			_notice("教學已看過，但暫時無法保存；下次仍會教學。")

	if not target.begins_with("game-"):
		if origin=="session" and session!=null:

func _start_dialogue(lines: Array, done: Callable, cancelled: Callable = Callable()) -> void:
	if lines.is_empty():
		if done.is_valid(): done.call()
		return
	if is_instance_valid(audio):
		audio.set_dialogue_active(true)
	dialogue=lines.duplicate(true)
	dialogue_index=0
	dialogue_done=done
	dialogue_cancelled=cancelled
	if not is_instance_valid(dialogue_panel):
		dialogue_panel=DialoguePanelScript.new()
		dialogue_panel.advance_requested.connect(_next_dialogue)
		dialogue_panel.finished.connect(_cancel_dialogue)
		dialogue_panel.tree_exiting.connect(_dialogue_panel_exiting.bind(dialogue_panel))
		ui.add_child(dialogue_panel)
		dialogue_panel.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
		_dialogue_panel_resized()
		if not get_tree().root.size_changed.is_connected(_dialogue_panel_resized):
			get_tree().root.size_changed.connect(_dialogue_panel_resized)
	else:
		dialogue_panel.show()
		dialogue_panel.set_process_unhandled_key_input(true)
	overlay.hide()
	hud.hide()
	world.set_dialogue_hold(true)
	world.blocked=true
	_render_dialogue()

func _render_dialogue() -> void:
	if dialogue_index>=dialogue.size():
		_finish_dialogue()
		return
	var line: Dictionary=dialogue[dialogue_index]
	var speaker := str(line.get("speaker", "旁白"))
	var dialogue_text := str(line.get("text", ""))
	if line.has("text_key"):
		var text_args: Dictionary = line.get("text_args", {})
		dialogue_text=Localization.text(str(line.text_key), text_args)
	dialogue_panel.show_line(speaker,dialogue_text,dialogue_index)
	if line.has("speaker_key"):
		var speaker_args: Dictionary = line.get("speaker_args", {})
		dialogue_panel.speaker_label.text=Localization.text(str(line.speaker_key), speaker_args)
	dialogue_label=dialogue_panel.text_label
	call_deferred("_dialogue_panel_resized")
	reveal=0
	modal_kind="dialogue"

func _next_dialogue() -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(dialogue_label): return
	if dialogue_label.visible_characters>=0 and dialogue_label.visible_characters<dialogue_label.text.length():
		reveal=dialogue_label.text.length()
		dialogue_panel.reveal_all()
	else:
		dialogue_index+=1
		_render_dialogue()

func _finish_dialogue(cancelled: bool = false) -> void:
	var callback := dialogue_done
	var cancel_callback := dialogue_cancelled
	dialogue_done=Callable()
	dialogue_cancelled=Callable()
	if is_instance_valid(dialogue_panel):
		dialogue_panel.set_process_unhandled_key_input(false)
		dialogue_panel.hide()
		dialogue_panel.queue_free()
	dialogue_panel=null
	dialogue_label=null
	dialogue.clear()
	if is_instance_valid(audio):
		audio.set_dialogue_active(false)
	overlay.hide()
	modal_kind=""
	if is_instance_valid(world):
		world.set_dialogue_hold(false)
		world.blocked=session!=null
	if is_instance_valid(hud): hud.show()
	if cancelled:
		if cancel_callback.is_valid(): cancel_callback.call()
	elif callback.is_valid():
		callback.call()

func _cancel_dialogue() -> void:
	_finish_dialogue(true)

func _dialogue_panel_exiting(panel: Control) -> void:
	if dialogue_panel!=panel: return
	if is_instance_valid(audio):
		audio.set_dialogue_active(false)
	dialogue_panel=null
	dialogue_label=null
	dialogue_done=Callable()
	dialogue_cancelled=Callable()
	dialogue.clear()
	if modal_kind=="dialogue":
		modal_kind=""
		if is_instance_valid(world):
			world.set_dialogue_hold(false)
			world.blocked=session!=null

func _dialogue_panel_resized() -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(dialogue_panel): return
	var scale_factor := Paper.physical_scale(dialogue_panel)
	Paper.adapt_menu(dialogue_panel, scale_factor)
	if is_instance_valid(dialogue_label): dialogue_label.custom_minimum_size.y=82.0/scale_factor
	var plaque := dialogue_panel.find_child("DialoguePlaque", true, false) as Control
	var height := 210.0/scale_factor
	if plaque != null:
		plaque.custom_minimum_size=Vector2(get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size.x-48.0/scale_factor,0)
		height=maxf(height,plaque.get_combined_minimum_size().y)
		plaque.custom_minimum_size.y=height
	var center := dialogue_panel.get_child(0) as CenterContainer
	center.anchor_top=1.0
	center.anchor_bottom=1.0
	center.offset_left=24.0/scale_factor
	center.offset_right=-24.0/scale_factor
	center.offset_top=-height-20.0/scale_factor
	center.offset_bottom=-20.0/scale_factor

	audio.play_sfx("interact")

		return
	if id.begins_with("game-"):
		_show_game_info(id)
	elif id=="arrival":
		_start_dialogue(story.intro_lines(),func(): Progress.intro_seen=true; Progress.save_progress(),func(): Progress.intro_seen=true; Progress.save_progress())
	elif id=="guide":
		_start_dialogue(story.main_lines(),func(): Progress.grant_photo("photo-welcome-story-1"); _notice("第一張主線拍貼，收進本子裡了。"))
	elif id=="quest-001" or id=="quest-002":
		var actor_lines := _actor_dialogue_lines(id)

			_record_story_mission_event({"type":"interaction","id":id})

	elif id=="ride-tide":
		if world.is_riding():
			world.end_ride()
		else:
			world.start_ride()
	elif id=="album": _show_album()
	elif id=="settings": _show_settings()
	elif id=="clock":
		world.set_night(not world.night)
		_notice("夜晚亮起來了。" if world.night else "陽光回到島上了。")
	elif id.begins_with("coast:"):
		var discovery: Dictionary = world.coast_description(id)
		if not discovery.is_empty():
			_start_dialogue([{ "speaker":str(discovery.name), "text":str(discovery.text) }],Callable())
	elif id.begins_with("explore-"): _show_exploration(id)
	elif id=="rift":
		var body := _open(title,"LITTLE DEVILS","rift")
		body.add_child(Paper.label("集齊迎賓大道十二張小惡魔拍貼，倒影大道的門就會記住你。\n目前 %d / 12。"%Progress.devil_count(),24))
		body.add_child(Paper.label("倒影大道正在準備新的布景；本版保留入口。",22))
		_back(body)
	elif id.begins_with("gate:"):
		var data: Dictionary=world.park_data()
		for zone in data.zones:
			if zone.id==id.trim_prefix("gate:"):
				var body := _open(zone.name,"NEXT ADVENTURE","gate")
				body.add_child(Paper.label(zone.theme,25))
				body.add_child(Paper.label("入園資格：%d 張不同普通拍貼（不消耗）\n目前：%d 張\n\n這座園區正在準備中。先去迎賓大道留下今天的回憶吧。"%[zone.threshold,Progress.normal_count()],22))
				_back(body)
				break

func _launch_game(id: String, assist: bool, practice: bool = false) -> void:
	if _definition(id).is_empty():
		_notice("這個設施暫時無法開啟，請先逛逛其他地方。")
		return
	photo_frames.clear()
	photo_original_frames.clear()
	next_snapshot=1.0

	modal_kind=""

	world.blocked=true

	session.finished.connect(_game_finished)

	session.note_played.connect(audio.play_note)
	session.feedback.connect(audio.play_gameplay_feedback)

		session.set_time_of_day(TimeOfDay.normalize(Progress.settings.get("time_phase", TimeOfDay.DEFAULT_PHASE)))
	session.start(id,assist)
	if practice and session.has_method("set_practice_mode"):
		session.set_practice_mode(true)
	audio.play_context("game")

func _game_finished(result: Dictionary) -> void:
	var id := str(result.get("game_id",""))
	var practice := bool(result.get("practice",false))
	var saved_frames: Array[String] = []
	var saved_original_frames: Array[String] = []
	if bool(result.get("success",false)) and not practice and DisplayServer.get_name()!="headless":
		# The completed session will draw its end overlay on the next frame. Keep
		# the most recent rendered gameplay image instead of photographing that UI.
		_append_photo_snapshot()
		saved_frames=_save_photo_frames(id)
		saved_original_frames=_save_photo_original_frames(id)
	if bool(result.get("success",false)) and not practice:
		celebrate_on_close=true
		Progress.complete_game(id,bool(result.get("devil",false)),bool(result.get("assisted",false)))
		_record_story_mission_event({"type":"minigame_result","id":id,"success":true,"practice":false})
		if not saved_frames.is_empty():
			_sync_finished_photo_thumbnails(result,saved_frames,saved_original_frames)
	_cancel_game()
	audio.play_sfx("success" if result.get("success",false) else "miss")
	var definition := _definition(id)

		award.add_child(Paper.icon("album",24,Paper.TEAL))

			award.add_child(Paper.icon("devil",24,Paper.CORAL))

	elif practice:

	else:
		body.add_child(Paper.label("沒有扣除任何收藏。也可以開啟輔助，試試別的節奏。",22))
	var result_columns := HBoxContainer.new()

	result_columns.add_theme_constant_override("separation",16)

	var detail := VBoxContainer.new()

	var score_summary: Dictionary=result.get("score_summary",{})
	var score_rows: Array=score_summary.get("rows",[])

		if score_row is Dictionary: rows.append(score_row)
	if rows.is_empty(): rows.append({"label":"本局分數已顯示於上方。","empty":true})
	_content_pager(detail,"ResultScorePages",rows,_render_score_row,1)
	if not practice:
		var frames := GridContainer.new()
		frames.name="ResultPhotoFrames"
		frames.columns=2
		frames.size_flags_horizontal=Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
		frames.size_flags_vertical=Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL

func _record_story_mission_event(evidence: Dictionary) -> void:
	for quest_id in ["quest-001", "quest-002"]:
		var cursor := int(Progress.quests.get(quest_id, 0))
		var event := evidence.duplicate(true)
		for _attempt in range(3):
			var result: Dictionary = story.mission_event_result(quest_id, cursor, event)
			if not bool(result.get("accepted", false)):
				# Saved source photos are durable proof of earlier real actions/results.
				# Practice games never persist their source photo, so cannot satisfy this path.
				var stored_evidence := _stored_mission_evidence(quest_id, cursor)
				if stored_evidence.is_empty():
					break
				event = stored_evidence
				result = story.mission_event_result(quest_id, cursor, event)
				if not bool(result.get("accepted", false)):
					break
			Progress.advance_quest(quest_id, int(result.get("next_step", cursor)))
			cursor = int(result.get("next_step", cursor))
			if bool(result.get("complete", false)):
				var reward_id := str(result.get("reward_photo_id", ""))
				if not reward_id.is_empty() and not Progress.photos.has(reward_id):
					Progress.grant_photo(reward_id)
				audio.play_sfx("success")
				break
			event = _stored_mission_evidence(quest_id, cursor)
			if event.is_empty():
				break

func _stored_mission_evidence(quest_id: String, cursor: int) -> Dictionary:
	var mission: Dictionary = story.quest_mission_data(quest_id)
	var steps: Array = mission.get("steps", [])
	if cursor < 0 or cursor >= steps.size():
		return {}
	var step: Dictionary = steps[cursor]
	var kind := str(step.get("kind", ""))
	var target_id := str(step.get("target_id", ""))
	if kind == "photo" and Progress.photos.has(target_id):
		return {"type":"photo_collected", "id":target_id}
	if kind == "observation":
		var proof_id := str(step.get("proof_photo_id", ""))
		if not proof_id.is_empty() and Progress.photos.has(proof_id):
			return {"type":"photo_collected", "id":proof_id}
	if kind == "minigame_result":
		var game_number := int(target_id.trim_prefix("game-"))
		var source_id := "photo-welcome-game-%d" % game_number
		if Progress.photos.has(source_id):
			return {"type":"minigame_result", "id":target_id, "success":true, "practice":false}
	return {}

	for i in range(photo_frames.size()):

func _save_photo_original_frames(id: String) -> Array[String]:

	if error != OK and error != ERR_ALREADY_EXISTS:
		push_warning("Cannot create original photo directory: " + directory)
		return paths
	for index in range(photo_original_frames.size()):
		var path := "%s/%s-original-%d.png" % [directory, id, index]
		if _save_bounded_photo_image(photo_original_frames[index], path):

	return paths

func _save_bounded_photo_image(image: Image, path: String) -> bool:
	if image == null or image.is_empty() or image.get_width() * image.get_height() > 4 * 1024 * 1024:
		push_warning("Skipping original photo outside the 4-megapixel limit: " + path)
		return false
	var error := image.save_png(path)
	var file_size := -1
	if FileAccess.file_exists(path):
		var saved_file := FileAccess.open(path, FileAccess.READ)
		if saved_file != null:
			file_size = saved_file.get_length()
			saved_file.close()
	if error != OK or file_size < 45 or file_size > 16 * 1024 * 1024:
		if FileAccess.file_exists(path):
			DirAccess.remove_absolute(path)
		push_warning("Cannot save bounded original photo: " + path)
		return false
	return true

		push_warning("Could not capture gameplay photo for "+str(session.game_id))
		return

func _append_photo_image(snapshot: Image) -> void:
	var original := _prepare_photo_original(snapshot)
	if original == null or original.is_empty():
		return
	var thumbnail := _prepare_photo_thumbnail(original)
	if photo_frames.size() >= Progress.MAX_GAME_PHOTO_FRAMES:
		photo_frames.pop_front()
	if photo_original_frames.size() >= Progress.MAX_GAME_PHOTO_FRAMES:
		photo_original_frames.pop_front()
	photo_frames.append(thumbnail)
	photo_original_frames.append(original)

func _prepare_photo_original(snapshot: Image) -> Image:
	if snapshot == null or snapshot.is_empty():
		return null
	var original := snapshot.duplicate()
	var pixels: int = original.get_width() * original.get_height()
	if pixels > 4 * 1024 * 1024:
		var scale := sqrt(float(4 * 1024 * 1024) / float(pixels))
		original.resize(maxi(1, floori(float(original.get_width()) * scale)), maxi(1, floori(float(original.get_height()) * scale)), Image.INTERPOLATE_LANCZOS)
	original.convert(Image.FORMAT_RGBA8)
	return original

func _prepare_photo_thumbnail(original: Image) -> Image:
	if original == null or original.is_empty():
		return null
	var thumbnail := original.duplicate()
	thumbnail.resize(320,180,Image.INTERPOLATE_LANCZOS)
	thumbnail.convert(Image.FORMAT_RGBA8)
	return thumbnail

func _fit_modal_viewport() -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(overlay) or not overlay.visible: return
	var center := overlay.find_child("AdaptiveMenuCenter",true,false) as CenterContainer
	if center!=null:

		# parent-sized extent after text/content adaptation so it can shrink again.
		center.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)

func _load_foliage_atlas() -> void:
	const ATLAS_PATH := "res://assets/world/tidal-foliage-v2.png"
	const REGIONS_PATH := "res://assets/world/foliage-regions.json"
	if not ResourceLoader.exists(ATLAS_PATH):
		_warn_foliage_once("atlas", "World foliage resource %s is unavailable; using procedural geometry fallback" % ATLAS_PATH)
		return
	var atlas := load(ATLAS_PATH) as Texture2D
	if atlas == null:
		_warn_foliage_once("atlas", "World foliage resource %s did not load as a Texture2D; using procedural geometry fallback" % ATLAS_PATH)
		return
	if not FileAccess.file_exists(REGIONS_PATH):
		_warn_foliage_once("regions", "World foliage region file %s is missing; using procedural geometry fallback" % REGIONS_PATH)
		return
	var parsed: Variant=JSON.parse_string(FileAccess.get_file_as_string(REGIONS_PATH))
	if parsed is not Dictionary:
		_warn_foliage_once("regions", "World foliage region file %s is invalid; using procedural geometry fallback" % REGIONS_PATH)
		return
	foliage_atlas_loaded=true
	for key in parsed:
		var rect: Variant=parsed[key]
		if rect is not Array or rect.size()!=4:
			_warn_foliage_once(str(key), "World foliage item '%s' in %s must contain x, y, width and height" % [key,REGIONS_PATH])
			continue
		var numeric := true
		for value in rect:
			if typeof(value)!=TYPE_INT and typeof(value)!=TYPE_FLOAT:
				numeric=false
				break
		if not numeric:
			_warn_foliage_once(str(key), "World foliage item '%s' in %s has nonnumeric rectangle values" % [key,REGIONS_PATH])
			continue
		var x := float(rect[0])
		var y := float(rect[1])
		var width := float(rect[2])
		var height := float(rect[3])
		if not is_finite(x) or not is_finite(y) or not is_finite(width) or not is_finite(height) or x<0.0 or y<0.0 or width<=0.0 or height<=0.0 or x+width>atlas.get_width() or y+height>atlas.get_height():
			_warn_foliage_once(str(key), "World foliage item '%s' rectangle %s exceeds %s bounds (%d x %d)" % [key,str(rect),ATLAS_PATH,atlas.get_width(),atlas.get_height()])
			continue
		var texture := AtlasTexture.new()
		texture.atlas = atlas
		texture.region = Rect2(x,y,width,height)
		foliage_textures[str(key)] = texture
	if foliage_textures.is_empty():
		foliage_atlas_loaded=false
		_warn_foliage_once("regions", "World foliage file %s has no valid atlas regions; using procedural geometry fallback" % REGIONS_PATH)

func _make_contact_shadow_material() -> StandardMaterial3D:
	var image := Image.create(32, 32, false, Image.FORMAT_RGBA8)
	for y in range(32):
		for x in range(32):
			var p := (Vector2(x, y) + Vector2(0.5, 0.5) - Vector2(16.0, 16.0)) / 16.0
			var edge := clampf(1.0 - p.length(), 0.0, 1.0)
			image.set_pixel(x, y, Color(0.12, 0.19, 0.20, edge * edge * 0.34))
	var material := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	material.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
	material.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
	material.albedo_texture = ImageTexture.create_from_image(image)
	material.texture_filter = BaseMaterial3D.TEXTURE_FILTER_LINEAR
	material.cull_mode = BaseMaterial3D.CULL_DISABLED
	material.depth_draw_mode = BaseMaterial3D.DEPTH_DRAW_OPAQUE_ONLY

	return material

static func sprite_ground_anchor_y(

static func _ground_surface_y(world_position: Vector3) -> float:
	# Match the tops of the raised boardwalk and authored district floors as well
	# as the plaza/avenue path; the lawn is the fallback.
	if world_position.z >= 8.4 and world_position.z <= 11.6 and world_position.x >= -5.7 and world_position.x <= -3.2:
		return lerpf(0.26,0.18,clampf(inverse_lerp(-5.7,-4.2,world_position.x),0.0,1.0))
	if world_position.x >= -13.5 and world_position.x <= -5.7 and world_position.z >= 7.2 and world_position.z <= 13.0:
		return 0.26
	if absf(world_position.z + 36.2) <= 1.8:
		if world_position.x >= 9.0 and world_position.x <= 13.8:
			return 0.58
		if world_position.x >= 6.5 and world_position.x < 9.0:
			return lerpf(0.2,0.60,inverse_lerp(6.5,9.0,world_position.x))
		if world_position.x >= 4.4 and world_position.x < 6.5:
			return 0.18
	if world_position.x >= -13.5 and world_position.x <= -4.5 and world_position.z >= -25.5 and world_position.z <= -15.5:
		return 0.17
	if world_position.x >= 4.3 and world_position.x <= 13.7 and world_position.z >= -33.8 and world_position.z <= -26.4:
		return 0.15
	if absf(world_position.x) <= 7.0 and world_position.z >= -43.75 and world_position.z <= -37.15:
		return 0.18
	if absf(world_position.x) <= 2.46 and world_position.z >= 14.825 and world_position.z <= 26.975:
		return 0.22
	if absf(world_position.x) <= 12.5 and absf(world_position.z) <= 8.0:
		return 0.18
	if world_position.x >= 4.4 and world_position.x <= 6.5 and absf(world_position.z + 36.2) <= 1.4:
		return 0.18
	if absf(world_position.x) <= 4.5 and world_position.z >= -47.0 and world_position.z <= 17.0:

func _register_sprite_ground_anchor(sprite: Sprite3D, anchor: Node3D, parent: Node3D, ground_y: float, feet_row: float, canvas_height: float) -> void:
	# Preserve the bottom pixel's entire area, including the one-pixel variation
	# between authored poses. The guard is less than a centimetre in world space.
	feet_row += SPRITE_FOOT_GUARD_PIXELS
	# NPC gait grounding may request a small extra vertical clearance when the
	# billboard's projected foot silhouette straddles a terrain-height boundary.
	sprite.set_meta("npc_world_ground_anchor_managed",true)
	sprite.set_meta("npc_foot_clearance_y",0.0)
	sprite_ground_anchors.append({
		"sprite": sprite,
		"anchor": anchor,
		"parent": parent,
		"ground_y": ground_y,
		"feet_row": feet_row,
		"canvas_height": canvas_height,
	})

func _update_sprite_grounding() -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(camera):
		return
	var camera_up_y := camera.global_basis.y.y
	for record in sprite_ground_anchors:
		var sprite := record.get("sprite") as Sprite3D
		var anchor := record.get("anchor") as Node3D
		var parent := record.get("parent") as Node3D
		if not is_instance_valid(sprite) or not is_instance_valid(anchor) or not is_instance_valid(parent):
			continue
		var ground_y := float(record.ground_y)
		if parent == player:
			ground_y = _ground_surface_y(player.global_position)
		var desired_y := sprite_ground_anchor_y(
			ground_y,
			parent.global_position.y,
			sprite.position.y,
			float(record.feet_row),
			float(record.canvas_height),
			sprite.pixel_size,
			camera_up_y
		)
		desired_y += float(sprite.get_meta("npc_foot_clearance_y",0.0))
		if absf(anchor.position.y - desired_y) > 0.0005:
			anchor.position.y = desired_y
	for index in range(contact_shadows.size()):
		var record: Dictionary = contact_shadows[index]
		var shadow := record.get("node") as Node3D
		var anchor := record.get("anchor") as Node3D
		if not is_instance_valid(shadow) or not is_instance_valid(anchor): continue
		var shadow_y := _ground_surface_y(anchor.global_position) - anchor.global_position.y + 0.005
		if absf(shadow.position.y - shadow_y) > 0.0005:
			shadow.position.y = shadow_y
		var ground_offset: Vector3 = record.get("ground_offset", Vector3.ZERO)
		ground_offset.y = shadow_y
		record["ground_offset"] = ground_offset
		contact_shadows[index] = record
	for proxy_record in actor_shadow_proxies:
		var proxy := proxy_record.get("node") as Node3D
		var actor := proxy_record.get("actor") as Node3D
		if not is_instance_valid(proxy) or not is_instance_valid(actor): continue
		proxy.position.y = 0.0 if actor == player and is_riding() else _ground_surface_y(actor.global_position) - actor.global_position.y

func _coastal_surface(tile_index: int, world_tile_size: float, tint := Color.WHITE) -> Material:
	if coastal_atlas == null:
		if not coastal_atlas_warning_shown:
			push_warning("Coastal material atlas failed to load; using simple fallback albedos.")
			coastal_atlas_warning_shown = true
		var fallback_tints: Array[Color] = [Color("#958064"),Color("#9b784f"),Color("#385d60"),Color("#a45c48"),Color("#ac9875"),Color("#417e82"),Color("#b6a57d"),Color("#8c774f")]
		var fallback_color: Color = tint if tint != Color.WHITE else fallback_tints[clampi(tile_index,0,7)]
		if tile_index == 0 or tile_index == 4:
			return _stone_finish(fallback_color)
		if tile_index == 1 or tile_index == 2 or tile_index == 3 or tile_index == 6:
			return _wood_material(fallback_color)
		return _mat(fallback_color)
	var key := "coastal:%d:%.2f:%s" % [tile_index,world_tile_size,tint.to_html(true)]
	if material_cache.has(key): return material_cache[key]
	var material := ShaderMaterial.new()
	material.shader = CoastalMaterialShader
	material.set_shader_parameter("atlas_texture",coastal_atlas)
	material.set_shader_parameter("tile_index",clampi(tile_index,0,7))
	material.set_shader_parameter("world_tile_size",maxf(0.1,world_tile_size))
	material.set_shader_parameter("tint",tint)
	material_cache[key] = material
	return material

	if source == null or source.is_empty():
		return 1.7

	return maxf(0.2,float(used.size.y) * sprite.pixel_size)

func _update_npc_name_labels(force := false) -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(camera):
		return
	var up_y := maxf(0.2,camera.global_basis.y.normalized().y)
	for record in character_sprites:
		var label := record.get("name_label") as Label3D
		var actor_root := record.get("activity_root") as Node3D
		if not is_instance_valid(label) or not is_instance_valid(actor_root):
			continue
		if not force and absf(float(record.get("name_camera_up_y",-1.0))-up_y)<0.001:
			continue
		var body_height := float(record.get("name_body_height",0.0))
		if body_height <= 0.0:
			body_height = _visible_body_height(record.get("sprite") as Sprite3D)
			record["name_body_height"] = body_height
		var font_height := ThemeDB.fallback_font.get_height(label.font_size) * label.pixel_size
		var outline_height := float(label.outline_size * 2) * label.pixel_size
		var text_half_height := (font_height + outline_height) * 0.5
		const HAIR_GAP := 0.075
		label.position.y = (body_height + HAIR_GAP + text_half_height) / up_y
		record["name_camera_up_y"] = up_y

func _npc_name_projected_gap(role: String) -> float:

	var text_height := ThemeDB.fallback_font.get_height(label.font_size) * label.pixel_size + float(label.outline_size * 2) * label.pixel_size
	return up.dot(label.global_position - (record.activity_root as Node3D).global_position) - text_height * 0.5 - body_height

func _build_coastal_planting_pockets() -> void:
	# Four loose edge pockets break up broad lawn patches; foliage is batched into two static multimeshes.
	var pocket_centers := [Vector3(-15.4,0,-31.8), Vector3(15.3,0,-23.8), Vector3(-15.1,0,-7.2), Vector3(15.2,0,4.0)]
	var blade_mesh := BoxMesh.new()
	blade_mesh.size = Vector3.ONE
	var flower_mesh := SphereMesh.new()
	flower_mesh.radius = 0.13
	flower_mesh.height = 0.26
	flower_mesh.radial_segments = 8
	flower_mesh.rings = 4
	var blade_transforms: Array[Transform3D] = []
	var blade_colors: Array[Color] = []
	var flower_transforms: Array[Transform3D] = []
	var flower_colors: Array[Color] = []
	for pocket_index in range(pocket_centers.size()):
		var center: Vector3 = pocket_centers[pocket_index]
		var pocket_radius := 0.5 + fposmod(float(pocket_index) * 0.19, 0.22)
		for blade_index in range(7):
			var angle := TAU * float(blade_index) / 7.0 + float(pocket_index) * 0.31
			var offset := Vector3(cos(angle) * pocket_radius, 0.28, sin(angle) * pocket_radius * 0.68)
			var tilt := Basis().rotated(Vector3.UP, angle).rotated(Vector3.FORWARD, sin(angle * 1.6) * 0.25)
			blade_transforms.append(Transform3D(tilt.scaled(Vector3(0.13, 0.58, 0.09)), center + offset))
			blade_colors.append(Color("#547a58") if blade_index % 2 == 0 else Color("#76905c"))
			if blade_index in [1, 4]:
				var flower_scale := 0.82 + fposmod(float(pocket_index + blade_index) * 0.17, 0.3)
				flower_transforms.append(Transform3D(Basis().scaled(Vector3.ONE * flower_scale), center + offset + Vector3(0,0.54,0)))
				flower_colors.append(Color("#d98768") if (pocket_index + blade_index) % 2 == 0 else Color("#e6ce8f"))
	_multi_mesh(blade_mesh, Vector3.ZERO, blade_transforms, blade_colors, _vertex_color_material("coastal-pocket-leaves"))
	_multi_mesh(flower_mesh, Vector3.ZERO, flower_transforms, flower_colors, _vertex_color_material("coastal-pocket-flowers"))

func _island_lawn_mesh() -> ArrayMesh:
	var mesh := ArrayMesh.new()
	var vertices := PackedVector3Array([Vector3.ZERO])
	var indices := PackedInt32Array()
	const SEGMENTS := 48
	for i in range(SEGMENTS):
		var angle := TAU*float(i)/SEGMENTS
		var dx := cos(angle)
		var dz := sin(angle)
		var extent := minf(36.0/maxf(absf(dx),0.0001),48.0/maxf(absf(dz),0.0001))
		var ragged := 1.0 + sin(angle*7.0+0.4)*0.022 + sin(angle*13.0-0.8)*0.013
		vertices.append(Vector3(dx*extent*ragged,0,dz*extent*ragged))
	for i in range(SEGMENTS):
		indices.append(0)
		indices.append((i+1)%SEGMENTS+1)
		indices.append(i+1)
	var arrays: Array=[]
	arrays.resize(Mesh.ARRAY_MAX)
	arrays[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX]=vertices
	var normals := PackedVector3Array()
	for i in range(vertices.size()): normals.append(Vector3.UP)
	arrays[Mesh.ARRAY_NORMAL]=normals
	arrays[Mesh.ARRAY_INDEX]=indices
	mesh.add_surface_from_arrays(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES,arrays)
	return mesh

func _build_shoreline() -> void:
	# Layered cut-paper shore ledges and foam stay outside the playable lawn.
	var shore_clusters := [-69.0,-43.0,-17.0,7.0]
	for side: float in [-1.0, 1.0]:
		for cluster_index in range(shore_clusters.size()):
			var center_z: float = shore_clusters[cluster_index]
			var rock_count := 2 + cluster_index % 2
			for rock_index in range(rock_count):
				var stagger := float(rock_index) - float(rock_count-1)*0.5
				var z := center_z + stagger*1.08 + sin(float(cluster_index*7+rock_index)*1.73)*0.24
				var x := side*(35.5 + cos(float(cluster_index*3+rock_index)*1.31)*0.52 + stagger*0.22)
				_add_shore_rock(Vector3(x,-0.12,z),cluster_index*5+rock_index)
			if cluster_index % 2 == 0:
				var foam := _box(Vector3(side*35.78,-0.20,center_z+0.24),Vector3(0.12,0.035,0.86),Color("#d2e5d8"))
				foam.rotation.y = side * 0.12
			if cluster_index == 1 or cluster_index == 3:
				_sea_grass(Vector3(side*34.5,0,center_z+0.45),cluster_index)
	for cluster_index in range(4):
		var center_x := -27.0 + cluster_index*18.0
		for rock_index in range(2):
			var stagger := float(rock_index)*0.9-0.45
			var x := center_x + stagger + sin(float(cluster_index*5+rock_index))*0.28
			var z := 19.0 + cos(float(cluster_index+rock_index)*1.7)*0.58

func _tree(pos: Vector3, seed_value: int) -> void:
	# Give each avenue band a coherent canopy instead of cycling through a
	# repeated random-looking row of unrelated tree silhouettes.
	var key := "oak"
	var tree_height := 4.35
	if pos.z > -16.0:
		key = "palm"
		tree_height = 4.15
	elif pos.z < -32.0 and pos.x < 0.0:
		key = "pine"
		tree_height = 4.6
	elif pos.z > -30.0 and pos.x > 0.0 and seed_value in [4, 7]:
		key = "ginkgo"
		tree_height = 4.3
	if _foliage_has(key):
		_foliage_sprite(key,pos,tree_height)
		_add_tree_shadow_proxy(pos,tree_height,key)
		return
	_cylinder(pos+Vector3(0,1.15,0),0.2,2.3,Color("#76583f"))
	for root in [-1,1]:
		var a: float = float(root) * TAU / 4.0 + 0.4
		var buttress := _box(pos+Vector3(cos(a)*0.33,0.25,sin(a)*0.33),Vector3(0.18,0.48,0.18),Color("#8a6948"))
		buttress.rotation.y = a
	for branch in [-1,1]:
		var arm := _box(pos+Vector3(branch*0.42,1.9,0),Vector3(0.13,1.0,0.14),Color("#76583f"))
		arm.rotation.z = branch * -0.58
	# Flat leaf clusters are batched per tree so the foliage stays crisp without
	# creating a separate mesh node for every printed leaf.
	var leaves: Array[Transform3D]=[]
	var leaf_colors: Array[Color]=[]
	var glints: Array[Transform3D]=[]
	var glint_colors: Array[Color]=[]
	for leaf in range(9):
		var a := float(leaf) * TAU / 9.0 + seed_value * 0.17
		var crown := Vector3(cos(a)*0.85,2.55+sin(leaf*2.4)*0.22,sin(a)*0.75)
		var basis := Basis().rotated(Vector3.UP,a).rotated(Vector3.FORWARD,sin(a)*0.18).scaled(Vector3(0.75,0.42,0.32))
		leaves.append(Transform3D(basis,crown))
		leaf_colors.append([Color("#3e7058"),Color("#54845d"),Color("#729365")][leaf%3])
		if leaf % 3 == 0:
			glints.append(Transform3D(Basis().rotated(Vector3.UP,a).scaled(Vector3(0.22,0.035,0.18)),crown+Vector3(0,0.23,0)))
			glint_colors.append(Color("#a1ad72"))
	var leaf_mesh := BoxMesh.new()
	leaf_mesh.size=Vector3.ONE
	_multi_mesh(leaf_mesh,pos,leaves,leaf_colors,_vertex_color_material("tree-leaves"))
	var glint_mesh := BoxMesh.new()
	glint_mesh.size=Vector3.ONE
	_multi_mesh(glint_mesh,pos,glints,glint_colors,_vertex_color_material("tree-glints"))
	if seed_value % 3 == 0:
		_lantern(pos+Vector3(0.4,2,0.7))

func _foliage_sprite(kind: String, ground: Vector3, world_height: float) -> Sprite3D:

	sprite.pixel_size=world_height/region_height
	sprite.texture_filter=BaseMaterial3D.TEXTURE_FILTER_NEAREST
	sprite.billboard=BaseMaterial3D.BILLBOARD_ENABLED
	sprite.shaded=true
	sprite.alpha_cut=SpriteBase3D.ALPHA_CUT_DISCARD
	sprite.alpha_scissor_threshold=0.45
	sprite.cast_shadow=GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
	sprite.position=ground+Vector3(0,world_height*0.5,0)
	var phase := fposmod(ground.x * 0.713 + ground.z * 0.391, TAU)

	return sprite


func _set_living_sprite_material(sprite: Sprite3D, kind: int, phase: float, breath_rate: float, idle_role := 0, animate_shader := true) -> ShaderMaterial:
	var material := ShaderMaterial.new()
	material.shader=LIVING_SPRITE
	material.set_shader_parameter("motion_kind",kind)
	material.set_shader_parameter("idle_role",idle_role)
	material.set_shader_parameter("phase",phase)
	material.set_shader_parameter("breath_rate",breath_rate)
	material.set_shader_parameter("breath_pixels",0.65)
	material.set_shader_parameter("gesture_pixels",0.65)
	material.set_shader_parameter("motion",1.0 if animate_shader else 0.0)
	material.set_shader_parameter("tint",Color.WHITE)
	var texture_source: Texture2D=sprite.texture
	var uv_rect := Rect2(0.0,0.0,1.0,1.0)
	if texture_source is AtlasTexture and texture_source.atlas != null:
		var atlas_texture := texture_source as AtlasTexture
		var atlas_size := Vector2(atlas_texture.atlas.get_width(),atlas_texture.atlas.get_height())
		uv_rect=Rect2(atlas_texture.region.position/atlas_size,atlas_texture.region.size/atlas_size)
		texture_source=atlas_texture.atlas
	material.set_shader_parameter("texture_albedo",texture_source)
	material.set_shader_parameter("uv_rect",Vector4(uv_rect.position.x,uv_rect.position.y,uv_rect.size.x,uv_rect.size.y))
	sprite.material_override=material
	if animate_shader:
		component_motion.register_shader(material)
	return material

func _district_occlusion_blocker(parent: Node3D, blocker_name: String) -> StaticBody3D:
	var blocker := StaticBody3D.new()

func _adopt_district_geometry(district: Node3D, first_child_index: int) -> void:
	for child_index in range(get_child_count()-1, first_child_index-1, -1):
		var scenery := get_child(child_index)
		if not scenery is GeometryInstance3D and not scenery is Label3D:
			continue
		remove_child(scenery)
		district.add_child(scenery)

	parent.add_child(district)

func park_data() -> Dictionary:
	var path := "res://design/01-park/park.json"
	var value: Variant=JSON.parse_string(FileAccess.get_file_as_string(path))
	if value is not Dictionary or value.get("zones") is not Array:
		push_warning("Invalid park data at "+path+"; entrances unavailable")
		return {"zones":[]}
	var zones: Array=[]
	for zone in value.zones:
		if zone is Dictionary and zone.get("id") is String and zone.get("name") is String and zone.get("theme") is String and zone.get("threshold") is float:
			zones.append(zone)
		else: push_warning("Invalid park zone at "+path+"; entry ignored")
	return {"zones":zones}

func _fit_npc_rest_texture(texture: Texture2D) -> Texture2D:
	var source := texture.get_image() if texture != null else null
	if source == null or source.is_empty(): return texture
	var used := source.get_used_rect()
	if used.size.x <= 0 or used.size.y <= 0: return texture
	var body := source.get_region(used)
	var scale := minf(float(NpcActivityScript.ACTION_MAX_HEIGHT)/used.size.y, float(NpcActivityScript.ACTION_CANVAS_SIZE.x-4)/used.size.x)
	body.resize(maxi(1,roundi(used.size.x*scale)),maxi(1,roundi(used.size.y*scale)),Image.INTERPOLATE_NEAREST)
	var canvas := Image.create(NpcActivityScript.ACTION_CANVAS_SIZE.x,NpcActivityScript.ACTION_CANVAS_SIZE.y,false,Image.FORMAT_RGBA8)
	canvas.fill(Color.TRANSPARENT)
	canvas.blit_rect(body,Rect2i(Vector2i.ZERO,body.get_size()),Vector2i((canvas.get_width()-body.get_width())/2,NpcActivityScript.ACTION_FEET_ROW-body.get_height()+1))
	return ImageTexture.create_from_image(canvas)

func _npc(pos: Vector3, color: Color, title: String) -> void:
	var activity_root := Node3D.new()

	var ground_anchor := Node3D.new()
	ground_anchor.name = "BillboardGroundAnchor"

	var role := "ticket"
	if title == "小角": role = "imp"
	elif title == "阿浪": role = "announcer"
	var identity_region: Rect2i = IDENTITY_REGIONS[role]
	if identity_textures.has(role):
		sprite.texture=identity_textures[role]
		sprite.pixel_size=2.4 / float(identity_region.size.y)
	else:
		sprite.texture=_character_texture(role,color,"front",0)
		sprite.pixel_size=0.05
	# Reduced motion restores this rest texture. It must use the same canvas and
	# foot row as activity frames, rather than an incompatible cropped identity.
	var rest_frames := NpcActivityScript.load_action_frames(role)
	if rest_frames.size() == 4:
		sprite.texture = rest_frames[0]
	else:
		sprite.texture = _fit_npc_rest_texture(sprite.texture)
	sprite.billboard=BaseMaterial3D.BILLBOARD_ENABLED
	sprite.texture_filter=BaseMaterial3D.TEXTURE_FILTER_NEAREST

	var feet_offset := float(NpcActivityScript.ACTION_FEET_ROW)-float(NpcActivityScript.ACTION_CANVAS_SIZE.y)*0.5
	sprite.position=Vector3(0.0,sprite.pixel_size*feet_offset,0.0)
	sprite.shaded=true
	sprite.cast_shadow=GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
	var breath_rate := 0.74 if role=="ticket" else (1.23 if role=="imp" else 0.53)
	var phase := 0.45 if role=="ticket" else (1.9 if role=="imp" else 3.2)
	var idle_role := 1 if role=="ticket" else (2 if role=="imp" else 3)

	_add_actor_shadow_proxy(activity_root,role,ground_y-activity_root.global_position.y)
	var name_label := _label(title,pos+Vector3(0,2.65,0),22)
	name_label.reparent(activity_root,true)
	character_sprites.append({"sprite":sprite,"activity_root":activity_root,"name_label":name_label,"role":role,"color":color,"base_position":sprite.position,"idle_profile":"mascot" if role=="imp" else ("welcoming" if role=="ticket" else "announcer"),"name_body_height":_visible_body_height(sprite),"name_camera_up_y":-1.0})

func _load_identity_atlas() -> void:
	if not ResourceLoader.exists(IDENTITY_ATLAS_PATH):
		_warn_identity_once("atlas","Character identity atlas %s is missing; using built-in NPC fallback art." % IDENTITY_ATLAS_PATH)
		return
	identity_atlas=load(IDENTITY_ATLAS_PATH) as Texture2D
	if identity_atlas == null:
		_warn_identity_once("atlas","Character identity atlas %s could not be loaded; using built-in NPC fallback art." % IDENTITY_ATLAS_PATH)
		return
	for role: String in IDENTITY_REGIONS:
		var region: Rect2i=IDENTITY_REGIONS[role]
		if region.position.x<0 or region.position.y<0 or region.size.x<=0 or region.size.y<=0 or region.end.x>identity_atlas.get_width() or region.end.y>identity_atlas.get_height():
			_warn_identity_once(role,"Character identity '%s' region exceeds %s bounds; using built-in fallback art." % [role,IDENTITY_ATLAS_PATH])
			continue
		var texture := AtlasTexture.new()
		texture.atlas=identity_atlas
		texture.region=Rect2(region)
		identity_textures[role]=texture
	if identity_textures.is_empty():
		identity_atlas=null
		_warn_identity_once("regions","Character identity atlas has no valid regions; using built-in NPC fallback art.")

func _warn_identity_once(key: String, message: String) -> void:
	if identity_warnings.has(key): return
	identity_warnings[key]=true
	push_warning(message)

func _pixel_rect(image: Image, x: int, y: int, width: int, height: int, color: Color) -> void:
	for py in range(y,maxi(0,y+height)):
		for px in range(x,maxi(0,x+width)):
			if px >= 0 and px < image.get_width() and py >= 0 and py < image.get_height():
				image.set_pixel(px,py,color)

func _pixel_triangle(image: Image, x: int, y: int, width: int, height: int, color: Color, point_up := true) -> void:
	for row in range(height):
		var progress := float(row) / maxi(1,height-1)
		var span := maxi(1,roundi(width*(1.0-progress))) if point_up else maxi(1,roundi(width*progress))
		var left := x + (width-span)/2
		_pixel_rect(image,left,y+row,span,1,color)

func _pixel_line(image: Image, start: Vector2i, finish: Vector2i, color: Color, thickness := 1) -> void:
	var x := start.x
	var y := start.y
	var dx := absi(finish.x-start.x)
	var sx := 1 if start.x < finish.x else -1
	var dy := -absi(finish.y-start.y)
	var sy := 1 if start.y < finish.y else -1
	var error := dx+dy
	while true:
		_pixel_rect(image,x-thickness/2,y-thickness/2,thickness,thickness,color)
		if x == finish.x and y == finish.y: break
		var doubled := 2*error
		if doubled >= dy:
			error += dy
			x += sx
		if doubled <= dx:
			error += dx
			y += sy

func _sync_avatar_motion_camera(discontinuous: bool = false) -> void:
	if not avatar_motion_available or not is_instance_valid(avatar_motion_rig) or not is_instance_valid(camera): return
	avatar_motion_rig.set_view_projection(camera.global_basis,atan2(camera.global_basis.z.x,camera.global_basis.z.z),discontinuous)

func _sync_external_avatar_reposition() -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(player): return
	var current_position := player.global_position
	if not avatar_last_physics_position_valid:
		avatar_last_physics_position=current_position
		avatar_last_physics_position_valid=true
		return
	var externally_repositioned := current_position.distance_to(avatar_last_physics_position)>AVATAR_EXTERNAL_REPOSITION_THRESHOLD
	if externally_repositioned and not is_riding():
		if is_instance_valid(avatar_hair_rig): avatar_hair_rig.reset_motion()
		# Keep relocation handling independent from the optional gait rig: the
		# camera must snap and stale velocity must not turn a teleport into a walk.
		if is_instance_valid(camera):
			camera.position=player.position+CAMERA_OFFSET
			camera.look_at(player.position+Vector3(0,1,0))
		player.velocity=Vector3.ZERO
		avatar_is_walking=false
		walk_distance_phase=0.0
		if avatar_motion_available and is_instance_valid(avatar_motion_rig):
			avatar_motion_rig.position.y=_ground_surface_y(player.global_position)-player.global_position.y
			_sync_avatar_motion_camera(true)
	avatar_last_physics_position=current_position

static func motion_sources_ready(records: Dictionary) -> bool:
	const REQUIRED_DIRECTIONS := ["front","front_right","right","back_right","back","back_left","left","front_left"]
	if records.size()!=REQUIRED_DIRECTIONS.size(): return false
	for direction in REQUIRED_DIRECTIONS:
		var record: Variant=records.get(direction,{})
		if not record is Dictionary or not bool(record.get("valid",false)): return false
	return true

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(player): return
	_sync_external_avatar_reposition()
	_update_district_label_visibility()
	if is_riding():
		if blocked:
			end_ride()
		else:
			player.velocity=Vector3.ZERO
			camera.position=camera.position.lerp(player.position+CAMERA_OFFSET,minf(1,delta*7))
			camera.look_at(player.position+Vector3(0,1,0))
			_update_sprite_grounding()
			_update_npc_name_labels()
			_refresh_avatar_texture(_ride_pose_frame())
			nearest={"id":"ride-tide","label":"離開潮汐貝殼輪","position":player.global_position,"marker":null}
			for point in points:
				var marker := point.get("marker") as Label3D
				if is_instance_valid(marker): marker.visible=false
			avatar_last_physics_position=player.global_position
			return
	var operating_lens: bool = is_instance_valid(coastal_play) and is_instance_valid(coastal_play.discoveries) and coastal_play.discoveries.controlling
	var movement := Vector2.ZERO if blocked or operating_lens else Input.get_vector("move_left","move_right","move_up","move_down")
	# Default travel is the comfortable jog; Shift keeps a slower, careful pace.
	avatar_run_requested = not blocked and not Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_SHIFT)
	var desired_speed := AVATAR_RUN_SPEED if avatar_run_requested else AVATAR_WALK_SPEED
	var desired_horizontal := movement*desired_speed
	var current_horizontal := Vector2(player.velocity.x,player.velocity.z)
	if blocked or operating_lens:
		current_horizontal=Vector2.ZERO
	else:
		if movement.length_squared()>0.0001: avatar_motion_speed_limit=desired_speed
		current_horizontal=current_horizontal.move_toward(desired_horizontal,avatar_motion_speed_limit*delta/AVATAR_ACCELERATION_SECONDS)
	player.velocity=Vector3(current_horizontal.x,-4.0,current_horizontal.y)
	var previous_position: Vector3=player.position
	var previous_world_position: Vector3=player.global_position
	player.move_and_slide()
	player.position.z=clampf(player.position.z,CoastalCircuit.WALK_BOUNDS.position.y,26.5)
	player.position.x=clampf(player.position.x,CoastalCircuit.WALK_BOUNDS.position.x,CoastalCircuit.WALK_BOUNDS.end.x)
	# Terrain edge: prevent stepping from the land directly into water.
	if player.position.z>18.0 and absf(player.position.x)>2.05:
		if previous_position.z>18.0:
			player.position.x=clampf(player.position.x,-2.05,2.05)
		else:
			player.position.z=18.0
	if player.position.z>18.6:
		player.position.x=clampf(player.position.x,-2.05,2.05)
	if player.position.y < -1.0:
		player.position=Vector3(0,0.3,10)
		previous_position=player.position
		previous_world_position=player.global_position
	var actual_world_delta := player.global_position-previous_world_position
	var horizontal_delta := Vector2(actual_world_delta.x, actual_world_delta.z)
	var travelled := horizontal_delta.length()
	avatar_is_walking = travelled > WALK_DISTANCE_EPSILON
	if avatar_is_walking:
		facing = quantize_walk_direction(horizontal_delta, facing)
		walk_distance_phase = advance_walk_phase(walk_distance_phase, travelled)
	if avatar_motion_available:
		avatar_motion_rig.position.y=_ground_surface_y(player.global_position)-player.global_position.y
		camera.position=camera.position.lerp(player.position+CAMERA_OFFSET,minf(1,delta*7))
		camera.look_at(player.position+Vector3(0,1,0))
		_sync_avatar_motion_camera()
		avatar_motion_rig.set_direction(facing)
		avatar_motion_rig.visible=false
		avatar_motion_rig.cancel_motion()
	var walk_frame_count := int(avatar_renderer.walk_frame_count(facing)) if avatar_renderer != null else 8
	var frame := walk_frame_for_phase(walk_distance_phase, walk_frame_count)
	if avatar_action_remaining > 0.0:
		if avatar_is_walking:
			# Gestures never hold a planted pose while the player translates.
			avatar_action_remaining=0.0
			avatar_action=""
		else:
			# Modal overlays pause the current pose and resume at the same phase.
			if not blocked:
				avatar_action_elapsed += delta
				avatar_action_remaining=maxf(0.0,avatar_action_remaining-delta)
				if avatar_action_remaining == 0.0: avatar_action=""
	_refresh_avatar_texture(frame)
	if is_instance_valid(avatar_hair_rig):
		var pixel_velocity := horizontal_delta / maxf(delta, 0.000001) / avatar.pixel_size
		avatar_hair_rig.advance(delta, pixel_velocity, blocked)
	camera.position=camera.position.lerp(player.position+CAMERA_OFFSET,minf(1,delta*7))
	camera.look_at(player.position+Vector3(0,1,0))
	if avatar_motion_available: _sync_avatar_motion_camera()
	_update_sprite_grounding()
	_update_npc_name_labels()
	var area := "海岸環線" if absf(player.position.x)>20.0 or player.position.z < -48.0 else ("海風碼頭" if player.position.z>12 else ("迎賓大道" if player.position.z < -11 else "中央廣場"))
	if area!=current_area:
		current_area=area
		area_changed.emit(area)
	avatar_last_physics_position=player.global_position
	nearest={}
	var best := 2.4
	for point in points:
		var dist := player.position.distance_to(point.position)
		if dist<best:
			best=dist
			nearest=point
	for point in points:
		var marker: Label3D=point.get("marker") as Label3D
		if is_instance_valid(marker): marker.visible=point.get("id","")==nearest.get("id","")

func _process(delta: float) -> void:
	if not blocked:
		time+=delta
		if not reduced_motion:
			for rotor in coastal_rotors:
				rotor.rotate_z(delta*float(rotor.get_meta("play_speed",0.18)))
	if is_instance_valid(player):
		lamp_selection_elapsed += delta
		if lamp_selection_elapsed >= LAMP_SELECTION_INTERVAL and player.global_position.distance_squared_to(lamp_selection_player_position) >= 0.04:
			_update_lamp_selection()
	sync_activity_pause()
	if not blocked and not pending_npc_interaction.is_empty():
		_play_pending_npc_interaction()

func sync_activity_pause() -> void:
	var pause_activity := blocked and not npc_dialogue_hold
	if is_instance_valid(npc_activity) and npc_activity_paused!=pause_activity:
		npc_activity_paused=pause_activity
		npc_activity.set_activity_paused(pause_activity)

func set_dialogue_hold(held: bool) -> void:
	npc_dialogue_hold=held
	if not is_instance_valid(npc_activity): return
	npc_activity.set_dialogue_hold(held)
	if held:
		npc_activity_paused=false
		npc_activity.set_activity_paused(false)
		_play_pending_npc_interaction()

func _on_interaction_requested(id: String, _label: String) -> void:
	var role := ""
	var action := "interact"
	match id:
		"guide":
			role = "ticket"
			action = "greet"
		"quest-001": role = "imp"
		"quest-002": role = "announcer"
		_: return
	var actor_record := _npc_record_for_role(role)
	var sprite := actor_record.get("sprite") as Sprite3D
	var actor_root := actor_record.get("activity_root") as Node3D
	if not is_instance_valid(sprite) or not is_instance_valid(actor_root) or not is_instance_valid(player): return
	var target_delta := Vector2(player.global_position.x - actor_root.global_position.x, player.global_position.z - actor_root.global_position.z)
	var direction := quantize_walk_direction(target_delta, "front")
	pending_npc_interaction = {"sprite": sprite, "action": action, "direction": direction}

func _play_pending_npc_interaction() -> void:
	if pending_npc_interaction.is_empty() or not is_instance_valid(npc_activity): return
	var request := pending_npc_interaction
	pending_npc_interaction = {}
	var sprite := request.get("sprite") as Sprite3D
	if not is_instance_valid(sprite): return
	match String(request.action):
		"greet": npc_activity.greet(sprite, String(request.direction))
		"interact": npc_activity.interact(sprite, String(request.direction))

func _npc_record_for_role(role: String) -> Dictionary:
	for actor_record in character_sprites:
		if String(actor_record.get("role", "")) == role:
			return actor_record
	return {}

static func quantize_walk_direction(world_delta: Vector2, previous_direction: String = "front") -> String:
	const COMPASS := ["back", "back_right", "right", "front_right", "front", "front_left", "left", "back_left"]
	if world_delta.length_squared() <= WALK_DISTANCE_EPSILON * WALK_DISTANCE_EPSILON: return previous_direction if COMPASS.has(previous_direction) else "front"
	var angle := fposmod(atan2(world_delta.x, -world_delta.y), TAU)
	var sector_width := TAU / float(COMPASS.size())
	var nearest := posmod(roundi(angle / sector_width), COMPASS.size())
	var previous := COMPASS.find(previous_direction)
	if previous >= 0:
		var previous_angle := float(previous) * sector_width
		var difference := absf(wrapf(angle - previous_angle, -PI, PI))
		if difference < sector_width * 0.5 + WALK_DIRECTION_HYSTERESIS:
			return previous_direction
	return COMPASS[nearest]

static func advance_walk_phase(phase: float, travelled: float) -> float:
	return fposmod(phase + maxf(0.0, travelled), WALK_STRIDE_DISTANCE)

static func walk_frame_for_phase(phase: float, frame_count: int = 8) -> int:
	var normalized_phase := fposmod(phase, WALK_STRIDE_DISTANCE) / WALK_STRIDE_DISTANCE
	var safe_frame_count := frame_count if frame_count in [8, 16] else 8
	return clampi(floori(normalized_phase * float(safe_frame_count)), 0, safe_frame_count - 1)

func interact() -> void:
	if is_riding():
		end_ride()
		return
	if not blocked and not nearest.is_empty():
		play_action("interact")
		interaction_requested.emit(nearest.id,nearest.label)

func _unhandled_key_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if blocked or not event is InputEventKey or not event.pressed or event.echo: return
	if event.keycode == KEY_F:
		play_action("wave")
		get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
	elif event.keycode == KEY_P:
		play_action("photograph")
		get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()

func play_action(name: String) -> void:
	var action := "photograph" if name == "photo" else name
	if action not in ["wave", "photograph", "interact", "celebrate"]: return
	var action_direction := _authored_action_direction(action, facing)
	if not action_direction.is_empty():
		# Face the authored pose before starting it, and keep that heading after
		# the sequence so the sprite does not snap back to an unsupported view.
		facing=action_direction
	else:
		_warn_missing_avatar_action_once(action)
	if avatar_motion_available and not is_riding():
		avatar_motion_rig.position.y=_ground_surface_y(player.global_position)-player.global_position.y
		avatar_motion_rig.cancel_motion()
	avatar_action=action
	avatar_action_remaining=_avatar_action_duration(action, action_direction if not action_direction.is_empty() else facing)
	avatar_action_elapsed=0.0
	_refresh_avatar_texture(0)

func _authored_action_direction(action: String, preferred_direction: String) -> String:
	if avatar_renderer == null:
		return ""
	if _has_authored_avatar_action(action, preferred_direction):
		return preferred_direction
	if _has_authored_avatar_action(action, "front"):
		return "front"
	for direction in AvatarRenderer.WALK_DIRECTIONS:
		if _has_authored_avatar_action(action, direction):
			return direction
	return ""

func _has_authored_avatar_action(action: String, direction: String) -> bool:
	if avatar_renderer == null:
		return false
	var library = avatar_renderer.animation_library
	if library == null:
		return false
	var actors: Variant = library.manifest.get("actors", {})
	var traveller: Variant = actors.get("traveller", {}) if actors is Dictionary else {}
	var action_entries: Variant = traveller.get(action, {}) if traveller is Dictionary else {}
	var entry: Variant = action_entries.get(direction, {}) if action_entries is Dictionary else {}
	if not entry is Dictionary:
		return false
	var frames: Variant = entry.get("frames", [])
	if not frames is Array or frames.is_empty():
		return false
	return avatar_renderer.has_authored_action(action, direction)

func _warn_missing_avatar_action_once(action: String) -> void:
	if _warned_missing_avatar_actions.has(action):
		return
	for direction in AvatarRenderer.WALK_DIRECTIONS:
		if _has_authored_avatar_action(action, direction):
			return
	_warned_missing_avatar_actions[action]=true
	push_warning("ParkWorld: traveller action '%s' has no authored direction in res://assets/characters/complete-animation-regions.json; using the three-frame built-in pose fallback." % action)

func _avatar_action_duration(action: String, direction: String = "front") -> float:
	if not _has_authored_avatar_action(action, direction):
		return 0.8
	var frame_count: int = avatar_renderer.authored_frame_count(action, direction)
	var fps: float = avatar_renderer.authored_action_fps(action, direction)
	if frame_count <= 0 or not is_finite(fps) or fps <= 0.0:
		return 0.8
	var duration: float = float(frame_count) / fps
	if not is_finite(duration) or duration <= 0.0:
		return 0.8
	return clampf(duration, 0.1, 8.0)

func set_avatar_look(appearance: Dictionary, equipped: Dictionary) -> void:
	if avatar_appearance == appearance and avatar_equipped == equipped: return
	var held_frame := maxi(0,last_avatar_frame)
	avatar_appearance=appearance.duplicate(true)
	avatar_equipped=equipped.duplicate(true)
	if avatar_motion_available:
		avatar_motion_rig.set_appearance(avatar_appearance,avatar_equipped)
	last_avatar_frame=-1
	_refresh_avatar_texture(held_frame)

func _refresh_avatar_texture(frame: int) -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(avatar) or avatar_renderer == null: return
	var riding := is_riding()
	var action := "sit" if riding else (avatar_action if avatar_action_remaining > 0.0 and not avatar_is_walking else ("walk" if avatar_is_walking else "idle"))
	var direction := "front" if riding else facing
	if avatar_motion_available:
		avatar_motion_rig.visible=false
	avatar.visible=true
	var display_frame := _ride_pose_frame() if riding else frame
	var texture_action := action
	if action == "idle" and not avatar_renderer.has_authored_action("idle", direction) and avatar_renderer.has_walk_atlas():
		# Directions without a dedicated idle sequence hold that direction's
		# authored walk stance; don't leave the loop on an arbitrary phase cel.
		display_frame=avatar_renderer.walk_idle_frame(direction)
		texture_action="walk"
	if action == "idle" and avatar_renderer.has_authored_action("idle", direction):
		var animation_library = avatar_renderer.animation_library
		display_frame=avatar_renderer.idle_frame_for_time(direction,time,reduced_motion)
	if action != "walk" and action != "idle" and not riding:
		var animation_library = avatar_renderer.animation_library
		if _has_authored_avatar_action(action, direction):
			display_frame=animation_library.frame_for_time("traveller", action, direction, avatar_action_elapsed if action == avatar_action else time, reduced_motion)
		else:
			# The built-in fallback has only three authored-looking poses. Advance
			# those safely instead of leaving it on the unrelated walk phase.
			display_frame=0 if reduced_motion else mini(floori(maxf(0.0,avatar_action_elapsed)*3.0),2)
	if last_avatar_direction == direction and last_avatar_frame == display_frame and last_avatar_action == action: return
	avatar.texture=avatar_renderer.texture(avatar_appearance,avatar_equipped,direction,display_frame,texture_action)
	if is_instance_valid(avatar_hair_rig):
		avatar.texture=avatar_hair_rig.sync_pose(avatar.texture,avatar_renderer,avatar_appearance,avatar_equipped,direction,display_frame,texture_action)
	var avatar_material := avatar.material_override as ShaderMaterial
	if avatar_material != null:
		avatar_material.set_shader_parameter("texture_albedo",avatar.texture)
	last_avatar_direction=direction
	last_avatar_frame=display_frame
	last_avatar_action=action

func _ride_pose_frame() -> int:
	if reduced_motion: return 0
	var moment := float(island_attractions.ride_elapsed()) if is_instance_valid(island_attractions) else 0.0
	if moment >= 2.0 and moment < 2.5: return 1
	if moment >= 5.0 and moment < 5.5: return 2
	if moment >= 5.5 and moment < 6.0: return 3
	return 0

func set_avatar_hair_motion_enabled(value: bool) -> void:
	var held_frame := maxi(0,last_avatar_frame)
	avatar_hair_motion_enabled=value
	if is_instance_valid(avatar_hair_rig): avatar_hair_rig.set_motion_enabled(value and not reduced_motion and DisplayServer.get_name()!="headless")
	last_avatar_frame=-1
	_refresh_avatar_texture(held_frame)

func set_night(value: bool) -> void:
	set_time_of_day("night" if value else "noon")

func set_time_of_day(phase_id: Variant) -> void:
	active_time_phase = TimeOfDayScript.normalize(phase_id)
	var profile: Dictionary = TimeOfDayScript.phase_for_id(active_time_phase)
	night = active_time_phase == "night"
	sun.rotation_degrees = profile.key_rotation_degrees
	sun.light_color = profile.key_color
	sun.light_energy = float(profile.key_energy)
	environment.background_color = profile.sky_color
	environment.ambient_light_color = profile.ambient_color
	environment.ambient_light_energy = float(profile.ambient_energy) * 0.58
	environment.fog_light_color = profile.sky_color.lerp(profile.ambient_color, 0.28)
	match active_time_phase:
		"dawn": environment.glow_intensity = 0.025
		"noon": environment.glow_intensity = 0.025
		"dusk": environment.glow_intensity = 0.045
		"night": environment.glow_intensity = 0.08
	lamp_energy_for_phase = float({"dawn": 0.18, "noon": 0.0, "dusk": 0.48, "night": 0.82}[active_time_phase])
	_update_lamp_selection(true)
	for record in contact_shadows:
		var shadow := record.get("node") as Node3D
		if not is_instance_valid(shadow): continue
		var ground_offset: Vector3 = record.get("ground_offset",Vector3.ZERO)
		shadow.position = ground_offset

func _update_lamp_selection(force := false) -> void:
	if not is_instance_valid(player): return
	if not force and lamp_selection_elapsed < LAMP_SELECTION_INTERVAL: return
	lamp_selection_elapsed = 0.0
	lamp_selection_player_position = player.global_position
	for slot in range(ACTIVE_LAMP_LIMIT):
		active_lamp_indices[slot] = -1
		lamp_candidate_distances[slot] = INF
	for lamp_index in range(lamps.size()):
		var lamp := lamps[lamp_index]
		if not is_instance_valid(lamp): continue
		var distance := player.global_position.distance_squared_to(lamp.global_position)
		for slot in range(ACTIVE_LAMP_LIMIT):
			if distance >= lamp_candidate_distances[slot]: continue
			for shift in range(ACTIVE_LAMP_LIMIT - 1, slot, -1):
				active_lamp_indices[shift] = active_lamp_indices[shift - 1]
				lamp_candidate_distances[shift] = lamp_candidate_distances[shift - 1]
			active_lamp_indices[slot] = lamp_index
			lamp_candidate_distances[slot] = distance
			break
	for slot in range(SHADOW_LAMP_LIMIT): shadow_lamp_indices[slot] = -1
	var shadow_count := 0
	for slot in range(ACTIVE_LAMP_LIMIT):
		var lamp_index := active_lamp_indices[slot]
		if lamp_index < 0: continue
		var lamp := lamps[lamp_index]
		var enabled := lamp_energy_for_phase > 0.0
		lamp.light_energy = lamp_energy_for_phase if enabled else 0.0
		lamp.shadow_enabled = enabled and active_time_phase in ["dusk", "night"] and shadow_count < SHADOW_LAMP_LIMIT
		if lamp.shadow_enabled:
			shadow_lamp_indices[shadow_count] = lamp_index
			shadow_count += 1
	for lamp_index in range(lamps.size()):
		if active_lamp_indices.has(lamp_index): continue
		var lamp := lamps[lamp_index]
		lamp.light_energy = 0.0
		lamp.shadow_enabled = false

func apply_settings(settings: Dictionary) -> void:
	reduced_motion=bool(settings.get("reduced_motion",false))
	set_avatar_hair_motion_enabled(avatar_hair_motion_enabled)
	sea_material.set_shader_parameter("motion",0.0 if reduced_motion else 1.0)
	fountain_water.set_shader_parameter("motion",0.0 if reduced_motion else 1.0)
	if is_instance_valid(component_motion): component_motion.set_reduced_motion(reduced_motion)
	if is_instance_valid(npc_activity): npc_activity.set_reduced_motion(reduced_motion)
	if is_instance_valid(occlusion_controller): occlusion_controller.set_reduced_motion(reduced_motion)
	if is_instance_valid(island_attractions): island_attractions.set_reduced_motion(reduced_motion)

func start_ride() -> bool:
	if blocked or not is_instance_valid(island_attractions):
		return false
	var started: bool = island_attractions.start_ride()
	if started:
		avatar_is_walking=false
		avatar_action=""
		avatar_action_remaining=0.0
		avatar_action_elapsed=0.0
		# The seat raises the player well above the ground; never solve ground
		# contacts while the 3D walk rig is hidden inside the ride pose.
		_refresh_avatar_texture(0)
		nearest={"id":"ride-tide","label":"離開潮汐貝殼輪","position":player.global_position,"marker":null}
	return started

func end_ride() -> void:
	if is_instance_valid(island_attractions):
		island_attractions.end_ride()
	if avatar_motion_available:
		avatar_motion_rig.position.y=_ground_surface_y(player.global_position)-player.global_position.y
		avatar_motion_rig.cancel_motion()
	avatar_is_walking=false
	avatar_action=""
	avatar_action_remaining=0.0
	avatar_action_elapsed=0.0
	_refresh_avatar_texture(0)

func is_riding() -> bool:
	return is_instance_valid(island_attractions) and bool(island_attractions.is_riding())

func _notification(what: int) -> void:
	if what == NOTIFICATION_APPLICATION_FOCUS_OUT and is_instance_valid(island_attractions):
		island_attractions.end_ride()

func update_collection(photos: Dictionary) -> void:
	for point in points:
		var source := ""
		if point.id.begins_with("game-"):
			source="photo-welcome-game-%d"%int(point.id.trim_prefix("game-"))
		elif point.id.begins_with("explore-"):
			source="photo-welcome-explore-%d"%int(point.id.trim_prefix("explore-"))
		elif point.id.begins_with("quest-"):
			source="photo-welcome-quest-%d"%int(point.id.trim_prefix("quest-"))
		elif point.id=="guide": source="photo-welcome-story-1"
		var marker: Label3D=point.marker
		marker.text="✓" if not source.is_empty() and photos.has(source) else "◇"
		marker.modulate=Color("#83d3ae") if marker.text=="✓" else GOLD

func refresh_label_fonts(font: Font) -> void:
	if font == null or font == _last_label_font:
		return
	_last_label_font = font
	for node: Node in find_children("*", "Label3D", true, false):
		(node as Label3D).font = font

 ball_point={"id":"play:ball","label":"踢海漂球","position":Ball.HOME,"marker":marker}

 world._point("play:recall","拿回海漂球",Vector3(-21.4,0.18,8.0))
